activity_summary: A damp proof, a ring in brown ink out to the margin, and Field's inky thumb beside the ring. Your face is not in it. The quire is already off the stone.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Saw the ring and the thumb, and did not touch the wet sheet.

entities.name: Richard Field
entities.context: His thumb is in the picture. The rest of him has gone on to the next forme.
